plain: We'll deliver the goods to your warehouse by October 10.
legal: The Seller shall deliver the Goods to the Buyer's warehouse no later than October 10.

plain: Ownership passes to you once you've paid in full.
legal: Title to the Goods shall pass to the Buyer upon payment in full.

plain: The risk passes to you when the goods are delivered.
legal: Risk in the Goods shall pass to the Buyer upon delivery.

plain: Check the goods when they arrive and tell us about any damage within 5 days.
legal: The Buyer shall inspect the Goods upon arrival and notify the Seller of any damage within five (5) days.

plain: We can deliver in several shipments.
legal: The Seller may deliver the Goods in installments.

plain: The minimum order is 100 units.
legal: The minimum order quantity shall be one hundred (100) units.

plain: Orders over $5,000 get free shipping.
legal: Orders exceeding $5,000 shall qualify for free shipping.

plain: Prices are valid for 30 days from the date of the quote.
legal: The prices stated in the quotation shall remain valid for thirty (30) days from the date thereof.

plain: Once you place an order, you can't cancel it without our approval.
legal: An order, once placed, shall not be cancelled without the Seller's consent.

plain: If we can't deliver within 2 weeks of the due date, you can cancel the order.
legal: If the Seller fails to deliver within two (2) weeks of the scheduled delivery date, the Buyer may cancel the order.

plain: The goods must meet the sample we showed you.
legal: The Goods shall correspond to the sample provided by the Seller.

plain: You can return faulty products for a replacement.
legal: The Buyer may return defective Products in exchange for replacements.

plain: Custom-made items can't be returned.
legal: Custom-made items shall not be eligible for return.

plain: We'll pack the goods so they don't get damaged in shipping.
legal: The Seller shall package the Goods in a manner adequate to prevent damage during transit.

plain: The buyer must unload the truck within 2 hours of arrival.
legal: The Buyer shall unload the vehicle within two (2) hours of its arrival.

plain: Waiting time over 2 hours is charged at $40 an hour.
legal: Any waiting time in excess of two (2) hours shall be charged at $40 per hour.

plain: We keep the right to stop delivery if you haven't paid earlier invoices.
legal: The Seller reserves the right to suspend delivery if any previous invoice remains unpaid.

plain: The buyer is responsible for import duties.
legal: The Buyer shall bear all import duties.

plain: The seller will provide a certificate of origin with each shipment.
legal: The Seller shall provide a certificate of origin with each shipment.

plain: Goods are shipped from our factory in Porto.
legal: The Goods shall be dispatched from the Seller's factory in Porto.

plain: We'll email you a tracking number once the order ships.
legal: The Seller shall provide the Buyer with a tracking number by email upon dispatch of the order.

plain: Delivery dates are estimates, not guarantees.
legal: Delivery dates are estimates only and shall not be binding.

plain: The car is sold with a full service history.
legal: The Vehicle is sold together with a complete service history.

plain: The seller confirms the mileage is accurate.
legal: The Seller warrants that the recorded mileage is accurate.

plain: The buyer will pay $8,200 in cash at the time of handover.
legal: The Buyer shall pay $8,200 in cash upon handover of the Vehicle.

plain: The seller will hand over both keys and the registration documents.
legal: The Seller shall deliver both keys and the registration documents to the Buyer.

plain: The laptop comes with a 2-year warranty.
legal: The Laptop is supplied with a warranty of two (2) years.

plain: The warranty doesn't cover accidental damage.
legal: The warranty shall not cover accidental damage.

plain: The supplier must deliver at least 95% of orders on time.
legal: The Supplier shall deliver not less than 95% of orders on time.

plain: If quality falls below standard twice, we can end the supply agreement.
legal: If the quality of the Goods falls below the agreed standard on two (2) occasions, the Buyer may terminate this Supply Agreement.

plain: We buy at least 1,000 crates per quarter.
legal: The Buyer shall purchase not less than 1,000 crates per quarter.

plain: The supplier can't sell the same design to our competitors.
legal: The Supplier shall not sell the Design to any competitor of the Buyer.

plain: Samples are free, but shipping for them is charged.
legal: Samples shall be provided free of charge; however, shipping costs shall be payable by the recipient.

plain: Each delivery must include a packing list.
legal: Each delivery shall be accompanied by a packing list.

plain: Goods that arrive damaged will be replaced at no cost.
legal: Any Goods delivered in a damaged condition shall be replaced free of charge.

plain: Payment terms for new customers are cash before delivery.
legal: New customers shall pay in full prior to delivery.

plain: Repeat customers can pay within 30 days.
legal: Existing customers may make payment within thirty (30) days.

plain: The online store ships to addresses in the EU and the UK only.
legal: The Online Store ships only to addresses within the EU and the UK.

plain: Gift cards can't be exchanged for cash.
legal: Gift cards shall not be redeemable for cash.

plain: Gift cards expire 12 months after purchase.
legal: Gift cards shall expire twelve (12) months from the date of purchase.

plain: Pre-orders will be charged when the item ships.
legal: Payment for pre-orders shall be taken upon dispatch of the item.

plain: We limit purchases to 2 per customer for limited editions.
legal: Purchases of limited-edition items shall be limited to two (2) per customer.

plain: Discount codes can't be combined.
legal: Discount codes may not be used in conjunction with one another.

plain: Sale items can only be exchanged, not refunded.
legal: Sale items may be exchanged but shall not be refunded.

plain: The distributor must buy at least $250,000 of products each year to keep exclusivity.
legal: The Distributor shall purchase Products with an aggregate value of not less than $250,000 per year in order to retain exclusivity.

plain: The distributor can only sell in its assigned territory.
legal: The Distributor shall sell the Products only within the Territory.

plain: The manufacturer will give 90 days' notice of any product being discontinued.
legal: The Manufacturer shall give ninety (90) days' notice of the discontinuation of any Product.

plain: Products must be stored in a dry place below 25 degrees.
legal: The Products shall be stored in a dry location at a temperature below 25 degrees.

plain: The buyer can reject any delivery that arrives after 5 pm.
legal: The Buyer may refuse any delivery arriving after 5 pm.

plain: We'll collect returned goods from your address at no charge.
legal: The Seller shall collect returned Goods from the Buyer's address free of charge.

plain: Refunds are issued once we've received and checked the returned item.
legal: Refunds shall be issued upon receipt and inspection of the returned item.

plain: The price includes installation but not removal of the old unit.
legal: The price includes installation but excludes removal of the existing unit.

plain: The furniture will be assembled on site by our team.
legal: The Furniture shall be assembled on site by the Seller's personnel.

plain: Delivery is to the ground floor only, unless you pay for extra service.
legal: Delivery shall be made to the ground floor only, unless the Customer purchases the additional service.

plain: The seller can change the specifications slightly as long as quality isn't reduced.
legal: The Seller may make minor changes to the specifications, provided that such changes do not reduce the quality of the Goods.

plain: Bulk orders need a 20% deposit.
legal: Bulk orders shall require a deposit of 20% of the order value.

plain: The deposit is credited against the final invoice.
legal: The deposit shall be credited against the final invoice.

plain: Any claim for missing items must be made within 72 hours.
legal: Any claim in respect of missing items shall be made within seventy-two (72) hours.

plain: We guarantee the coffee beans were roasted within the last 14 days.
legal: The Seller warrants that the coffee beans were roasted within the fourteen (14) days preceding dispatch.

plain: The auction winner must pay within 48 hours.
legal: The successful bidder shall make payment within forty-eight (48) hours.
